Paper Organization and Notation The rest of the paper is organized as follows. In Section 2, we formalize the class of online algorithms and state our hardness results. Section 3 is devoted to the algorithmic problem of finding constant discrepancy solutions. See Section 3.1 for preliminaries and the definition of set of m-tuples regarding OGP, Section 3.2 for the main m-OGP result and Section 3.3 for the hardness result against stable algorithms. Finally, see Appendix A for complete proofs. Our notation is fairly standard, see the beginning of Appendix A for details.
